question: How can all aims be accomplished in dangerous situations through mantra recitation?
premises: The scope of accomplishment is all aims.
The practice is effective in the situations previously listed.
inference: By mere recitation, one should accomplish all aims in those situations.
uncertainties: The role of viprāṇāṃ (for brahmins or by brahmins) is ambiguous.
plain_english: By mere recitation, one should accomplish everything, as in the case of brahmins.
